summary: RETEST of iteration_16 refresh-persistence bug PASSED across all 3 staff pages. Backend regression (test_iter16_cookie_auth.py) 7/7 PASS. Frontend Playwright tests: /admin (admin1/admin123), /walkin (chelyn/Chelyn123456), /checkin (admin3/admin123) — all login succeed, /api/admin/me returns 200 via httpOnly cookie only, localStorage.mbi_admin_token === null while mbi_admin_user is present, and hard page reload keeps user on the dashboard (password input count = 0 after reload). Logout button on /admin is discoverable (count=1) and clicking it clears mbi_admin_user and returns to the login screen. Fix in AdminPage.js:1594 / WalkinPage.js:97 / CheckinPage.js:66 (useState(!!getAdminUser())) is verified in place. No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: setAdminSession(token, user) still accepts and discards token — recommend simplifying signature to setAdminSession(user) to prevent future re-introduction of token in localStorage.

Consider a mount-time /api/admin/me probe on the 3 staff pages so the httpOnly cookie is the single source of truth (currently relies on mbi_admin_user presence which is derived state). Not a bug — cookie+user stay in sync via logout — but more robust.
server.py still ~1950 lines, not split into routers (carried over from iter16).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 staff pages persist across reload; logout works)
